steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Add 100 mg phenazine methosulfate (PMS) to 100 ml of 10 mM Tris–HCl buffer in a 100 ml thin‑stemmed round‑bottomed glass flask.

steps.title: Adjust pH to 7.4
steps.instruction: Measure the pH and adjust to 7.4 with 0.5 M NaOH solution.

steps.title: Photolyze mixture
steps.instruction: Place the flask 25 cm from a Phillips TLD 18 W/54 fluorescent tube and expose for 2.5 h.

steps.title: Extract with chloroform
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction mixture to a separation funnel inside a fume hood, add chloroform, allow phase separation, and collect the lower (organic) chloroform phase containing pyocyanin into a pear‑shaped flask.

steps.title: Evaporate chloroform under nitrogen
steps.instruction: Bubble nitrogen gas through the pear‑shaped flask until all chloroform evaporates, leaving a blue pyocyanin sludge.

steps.title: Resuspend sludge in chloroform
steps.instruction: Resuspend the blue sludge in 50 ml chloroform.

steps.title: Acidify and basify sequentially
steps.instruction: Add 50 ml of 0.1 M HCl to the chloroform solution (pyocyanin turns red), then add another 50 ml chloroform, followed by a few drops of 500 mM NaOH to convert the red pyocyanin back to blue. Perform two additional chloroform extractions with 50 ml chloroform each.

steps.title: Freeze overnight
steps.instruction: Store the pyocyanin chloroform solution at –20 °C overnight.

steps.title: Evaporate and concentrate
steps.instruction: Gently evaporate chloroform by nitrogen insufflation, resuspend the residue in a small volume of chloroform, transfer to a vertical Pyrex glass tube and evaporate the chloroform completely.

steps.title: Hexane wash and crystallize
steps.instruction: Add hexane to the tube, swirl, and aspirate the hexane (pyocyanin is insoluble). Add 1 ml chloroform, then add 5–8 ml hexane drop‑wise, wait 10 min; crystals of pyocyanin form automatically.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect crystals
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to 50 ml polypropylene tubes and centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 10 min. Discard the supernatant and move the lower phase containing crystals into a piston‑less polypropylene syringe fitted to a type EH 0.5 µm filter apparatus; crystals remain on the filter.

steps.title: Methanol elution and drying
steps.instruction: Elute the trapped crystals with methanol into a screw‑capped glass bottle, evaporate methanol by nitrogen bubbling, dissolve the residue in a small amount of methanol, store at –20 °C overnight, evaporate methanol again by nitrogen, and finally re‑dissolve the pyocyanin in 0.5 ml chloroform.

steps.title: Activate TLC plate
steps.instruction: Prepare a silica TLC plate for use.

substeps.instruction: Scrape excess silica from three edges of the plate.
Place the plate vertically in a glass cage (no paper lining) containing 10 ml methanol; the most damaged edge contacts the methanol.
Cover the cage with a glass plate.
Remove the plate when the methanol front reaches 2 cm from the top edge.
Leave the plate outside the cage, inside the hood, for 10 min.
Place the plate on a folded A4 sheet, silica side up, and microwave at minimum power for 5 min.
Increase microwave power to setting 3 and heat for an additional 10 min.
Store the activated plate in the dark or a desiccator until use.

steps.title: Apply pyocyanin to TLC
steps.instruction: Using a Camag Nanomat with a 1 µl (or 5 µl) glass tip, apply 0.25 ml of the pyocyanin chloroform solution onto the silica side of the activated TLC plate.

steps.title: Develop TLC plate
steps.instruction: Develop the plate in a glass cage (paper‑lined) containing a 12.5 ml chloroform + 12.5 ml methanol mixture; stop development when the solvent front is 2 cm from the top edge.

steps.title: Scan TLC plate
steps.instruction: Remove the plate, scan it with a computer scanner, and save the image.

steps.title: Scrape silica and extract
steps.instruction: Carefully scrape the silica layer containing pyocyanin from the glass side of the plate, dissolve the scraped material in 2 ml methanol in a screw‑capped glass bottle.

steps.title: Centrifuge extract
steps.instruction: Transfer the methanol solution to small glass tubes compatible with the refrigerated centrifuge and centrifuge twice (lid partially closed, only top trap lid shut).

steps.title: Spectrophotometric quantification
steps.instruction: Set the spectrophotometer to Abs mode, range 0.0–0.5, wavelength 200–800 nm, fast scan speed, 1 nm sampling interval. Blank with two methanol‑filled quartz cuvettes (1 cm path, 1 ml). Verify baseline (absorbance ≈0). Dilute the pyocyanin methanol solution 1:100 (10 ml sample + 990 ml methanol) in the sample cuvette, then record absorbance at 718 nm, 318 nm, and 239 nm.

steps.title: Calculate pyocyanin concentration
steps.instruction: Use A = E × L × C (L = 1 cm). At 318 nm, E = 30 199.5 (methanol). Compute C = A/E × 100 (dilution factor). Adjust the solution by drying methanol with nitrogen or adding methanol until a 1 mM concentration is achieved.
